name: Isometric Word-Avoidance Cubes
summary: Induced subgraphs of hypercubes on fixed-length strings avoiding a finite isometric set of forbidden consecutive factors.
parameters: A length $k$ and a finite forbidden set $S$ that is isometric in the word-avoidance sense.
comments: The empty forbidden set gives hypercubes; the forbidden word 11 gives Fibonacci cubes.
